SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4626
Date 11 / 4 / 33

April 11, 1933.                                    Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS.

Shen Pao and other local newspapers:-

CHANG HSUEH LIANG BOARDS THE S.S. CONTE ROSSO.

    Ex-Marshal Chang Hsueh Liang, the former
Chief of the Peiping Branch of the Military Affairs
Committee, boarded the Italian liner "Conte Rosso" with
his family last night. The ship will leave port this
morning.
    Count Ciano, the Italian Minister, together
with his wife, are leaving China by the same steamer.
    Dr. T.V. Soong, Mayor Wu Te Chen, Madame Soong
Mei Ling, Dr. H.H. Kung, Messrs. Doo Yueh Sen, King
Tseoo Ling, A Chung Chuang, Yang Chih Yuan and others
saw Chang off at 11 p.m. yesterday.
    The Customs Jetty was strictly guarded by
Customs officers while the River Police escorted the
launch which conveyed Chang to the vessel. The French
Police detailed many officers to offer him protection.
    The ship is due to arrive in Italy on May 3.

Shen Pao and other local newspapers.-

THE KIDNAPPING OF A KOREAN.

    After the kidnapping of Lee Chun San, a Korean
who is a naturalized Chinese citizen, on Lu Pan Road,
Nantao, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai gave strict
instructions to the Bureau of Public Safety to arrest
the persons concerned. Some days ago, the Bureau
arrested a suspect named Tsao Teh Hao who stated that
it was two Japanese who had organized the kidnapping.
    Lee Chun San alias Lee Yu Ti, holds naturaliza-
tion certificate No. 11 from the Ministry of Interior,
and was a law-abiding citizen living in Chinese territory.
    According to the North China Daily News, the
Korean kidnapped by the Japanese has already been sent to
Korea. If this is true, the Municipality regards it
as a serious matter.
    The Municipality has sent a letter to the
Japanese Consul requesting him to investigate.

China Times and other local newspapers:-

ASSISTANCE OF VOLUNTEERS' FAMILIES IN SHANGHAI.

    The Federation of Various Benevolent Societies
in Shanghai has rented houses in the French Concession
to accommodate the families of Wang Teh Ling and his fellow
volunteers of the North-East. The Federation has also
established places where the members of the families of
Wang and his followers may some learn manual trade or
receive rudimentary education. The maintenance expenses
are estimated at $1,500 per mensem. The Federation
will endeavour to maintain them, with the assistance of
other public bodies, for a period of six months.

刑事与特别课登记处。
编号 D 4626
日期 1933年4月11日

1933年4月11日。                                    晨间译件

杂项。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

张学良登上“孔特·罗索”号轮船。

    前军事委员会北平分会委员长、前元帅张学良，昨晚携家眷登上了意大利邮轮“孔特·罗索”号（Conte Rosso）。该船将于今晨离港。
    意大利公使齐亚诺伯爵（Count Ciano）及其夫人也将乘坐同一艘轮船离开中国。
    宋子文博士、吴铁城市长、宋美龄女士、孔祥熙博士，以及杜月笙先生、金廷荪先生、朱阿庄（音译）、杨志远先生等人于昨晚11时前往送行。
    海关码头由海关人员严密警戒，水上警察则护送载运张学良前往轮船的汽艇。法国警方派遣多名警员为其提供保护。
    该船预计于5月3日抵达意大利。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

一名朝鲜人被绑架案。

    在南市鲁班路发生已归化为中国公民的朝鲜人李春山（Lee Chun San）被绑架一案后，大上海市政府向公安局下达严令，要求逮捕涉案人员。日前，公安局逮捕了一名名为曹德浩（Tsao Teh Hao）的嫌疑人，其供称系两名日本人策划了此次绑架。
    李春山，又名李玉蒂（Lee Yu Ti），持有内政部颁发的第11号归化证书，是一名居住在中国领土内的守法公民。
    据《字林西报》报道，被日本人绑架的这名朝鲜人已被送往朝鲜。若此事属实，市政府视其为严重事件。
    市政府已致函日本领事，要求其进行调查。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

援助上海志愿人员家属。

    上海各慈善团体联合会已在法租界租赁房屋，以安置王德龄及其东北志愿人员同僚的家属。该联合会还设立了场所，供王及其追随者的家属成员学习手工技艺或接受基础教育。维持费用估计为每月1,500元。该联合会将在其他公共团体的协助下，尽力维持他们六个月的生活。
